reviews.text: they are amazing, they have done so many incredible things for the fur child

I do not recommend. They are so strict on the timeline for prescription refills that I cannot get my dog 3 nextgard tablets because his annual is December 10 and he just had his last pill in September. That is exactly 3 months of treatment for October, November, and December (which is his exam month), but they will not authorize without a new visit. I am going to visit another vet.
The doctors are amazing along with the other staff. They are very informative and provide excellent care.
Hi, Esther.  Thank you so much for your kind review and trust with your furry family member. We look forward to seeing you both again soon!
Sickeningly overpriced.
Fast, welcoming, and effective. Scheduling the appointment online proved straightforward and swift.
Hi, Connor. Thank you so much for rating your experience with us so highly!
Love it, everything about our first visit was amazing and friendly! I recommend you to bring your fur baby

We had amazing experiences with GoodVets in Kansas and were excited to switch when we moved to Dallas.  Dr. Motley and the front desk staff were amazing.  The nurse was a bit uninterested in 'anything' to be quite honest.  The problem is we waited to sign up for a plan before seeing if our dog needed surgery or just senior care.  We left having to pay 840.00 because their sign-up website was having issues.  We applied again at home, on the computer, and were denied the monthly payment plan.  We could do the wellness plan if we paid in full (which we couldn't afford another 1000.00 at that time).  Now, the doctor is calling wanting to do more tests on my dog for numbers that are in range that will cost 400.00 more.  If we could have done the 85.00 a month payment plan we would be able to consider this option.  However, we can't get on any plan until we come up with another 1000.00 in order to start it.  Instead, we will have to seek a better vet that is more interested in helping our pets than just taking our money.  It's too bad because our dog really took to Dr. Motley.

I know my babies are in good hands when I bring them to GoodVets. It’s a nice, clean, new/newly renovated building that makes me feel welcome. Customers services is A1 and my babies were in such great temperament with the vets. Thank you for taking care of my babies!

First of all I’d like to give compliments to Dr. Motley! My aunt brought her dog in last week and all she talked about was how kind and thorough Dr. Motley was to her and the care for her fur baby. Thank you Dr. Motley and GoodVets Uptown!
I just LOVVVE Dr. Motley! She is always so attentive with my little Luna, and she was an angel when my fur baby had puppies! This is the only vet I’ll go to from now on. <3
Hi, Spjk. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for trusting us with your pet!

I love this place staff is friendly and knowledgeable
Dr. Motley is the best
great place super friendly staff.
Awfull Customer service.

I brought my dog in for a bad skin infection and we were treated with zero judgment from any of the staff. From the moment I walked in, everyone was extremely friendly to both me and my pup. Dr Herman took her time in the room, made sure to thoroughly explain everything, and answered my million questions. You can tell everyone at this clinic truly cares! This will be my new permanent vet clinic and I highly recommend.

I found GoodVets through Google and tried their service. My cat had a urinary infection (UTI), so I booked an appointment online to drop-off the pet within hours. Some 20 minutes after dropping off the cat, I received a phone call from another doctor, not the doctor who admitted the cat. She stated a brief of the pet's condition and asked for $1,200 for treatment. I was distracted driving, and she failed to detail the charges for the procedure. Besides... That doctor did not sound compassionate enough to do the job, so I declined the treatment. I went back to pick up the cat, but no doctor came out to advise or convey the urgency of an intervention, although I paid for consultation and vaccination. I intended to take my pet to another vet the next day, but the cat died overnight.

There is no substitute for hands-on, face-to-face consultation! Convenience, indifference, and miscommunication were factors to the loss and great sorrow to me. The online registration for a drop-off and telephone call became a new-customer dead trap for my beloved animal. I do not know if I can ever forgive myself for taking such an insensitive offer.

"Oh dear, Pijito... Forgive me for placing you into objectionable accommodations."
Hi, L. Your feedback is highly appreciated. Thank you so much for the review!
When I needed a vet most (my dog was hurt) I was told to go somewhere else. Will never go there again

Hi, Domonique. At GoodVets Uptown (Dallas), we aim to provide positive experiences at all times and would like the chance to learn more about how we fell short. Please send us an email so we can chat further.

Front desk and technician are kind and helpful. My dog last tooth is falling out of his mouth. He's a senior dog. I brought him up there a couple times in the last few weeks and was giving no pain medicine either time. Yesterday I brought him up there and he received one shot that cost $77 and it only lasted for 14. I called another clinic nearby and they don't even charge nothing but like $20 for the shot. I was told that I might have to put my dog down because it possibly wasn't a tooth and the medicine might not work. The medicine worked and now I'm trying to get more pain medicine until my dog last tooth falls out. Really hope that the veterinarian will LISTEN this time and give my baby relief from the pain and his tooth. Instead they want to run expensive test and it's stuff. I would really hate to go through my bank and dispute all charges or file complaints with a better Business bureau.. I'm a veteran and a Jehovah witness I have no need to lie. They gave me a corporate number and they don't even have a corporate office. I had to file disputes with my bank and switch to another clinic. It's a shame because it's conveniently close and I'm disabled but treatments are not up to par. Giving my baby nerve medicine instead of pain medicine for his teeth.
I live downtown now so that's why I switched 😭

Update: We were able to get my service animal into another veterinarian and they didn't suggest putting him down. Good vet never even called to check on my baby 🙏
Hi, K. We appreciate the rating, and are glad we could provide you with a positive experience!
Hi, Eric.  Thank you so much for your kind review and trust with your furry family member. We look forward to seeing you both again soon!
Thank you so much for helping my dog!!

We’ve been using GoodVets since we got our pup Ember from the shelter, and we absolutely loved Dr. Luevano, who, unfortunately, is no longer there. We always felt incredibly welcome and respected, and our pup was treated with the same respect.

But, seriously, things have gone downhill in the past couple of months. We no longer see the DVMs we were familiar with and are stuck with relief DVMs. The first time, I was shocked because the DVM seemed terrified of our dog. Let me be clear, I own a 2-year-old female German Shepherd mix who is the sweetest thing ever, greeting everyone with kisses and love. This DVM barely did a basic exam, rushed through my questions, and then bolted out of the room. I thought, “Well, it’s just a relief vet, so hopefully, we won’t have to deal with her again.”

Our next appointment was with another relief vet, Dr. Davis, and I made sure to remember her name because the experience was absolutely dreadful. We took our pup in for a possible (TMI!!!!) prolapse, and all Dr. Davis did was glance at it, declared everything was fine, and tried to leave. I asked what it could be because, obviously, we can’t just ignore something red coming out of our dog’s butt, and suggested it might be her anal glands. She sighed and said, “Sure, we can express her glands,” which wasn’t what I was asking at all. My partner and I exchanged several exasperated glances at the lack of understanding and basic human decency this DVM showed. After the expression, she just yanked off her gloves and said, “If it happens again, just push it in and take her to the vet,” before leaving the room. No internal examination, nothing.

I asked the technician, whose name I wish I remembered because she made the ordeal almost bearable, how that advice was any different from what we did today. She patiently walked us through the process and recommended pro and prebiotics for our pup.

After this infuriating encounter, we decided we were done with GoodVets. The decency they once had vanished with their previous veterinarians. I took her to another vet who actually did an examination and figured out it was her anal glands. We wasted almost $200 at GoodVets just to go to another vet who properly assessed the situation and did their job.

As someone who is striving to get into veterinary school, I can’t believe it’s not as competitive if these are the types who have recently graduated.

Brought my perfectly healthy, adult dog in for a health certificate for a move and they denied it because it was "maybe going to be too hot (above 90°), maybe not" (forecast of 66° the morning we leave). Absolutely wild to deny a certificate based on the possibility that it could possibly maybe be 20° hotter than the forecasted temp 24 hours from now. I've worked in the animal welfare and medical industry my entire life and I'll be sure to warn people of their ridiculous and unreasonable veterinarian who didn't even once look at the dog.
I always feel like I’m in great hands with GV. Thanks you Dr. Lorien and Team!

I can’t say enough great things about this place! (A little more on the expensive side) but I hadn’t found a new vet since moving to Dallas for my 9 y/o maltipoo. Brought him in for a sudden pancreatitis flare up. First day I had an appt and the second day I showed up in panic mode right when they opened and they fit me in immediately. Experienced two different vets and multiple vet techs. They were all so wonderful and incredibly caring and really listened to my concerns. The front desk girl was the same both days and she was also so sweet! Absolutely recommend this place to anybody who sees their fur babies as their kids!!
Thank you for the review! We truly appreciate your support!

I’ve switched vet clinics for past bad experiences and finding a clinic with vet techs and doctors that had patience for my babies was a rollercoaster until I found Good Vets. So far I’ve had every doctor and vet tech be so gentle to my girl Bella and she already dislikes her vet visits, so the last thing I want is to continue to ruin her experiences. I know my Bella is reactive and can be snappy and my past experiences were techs and a doctor completely give up on my girl, which left me discouraged…

I take the drive from Grand Prairie to Uptown because my girls have had better experiences with their visits now with the techs and the doctors here at Good Vets.

Unfortunately today was not a great experience for both of us.  My girl Bella needed her due allergy shot and the vet tech that retrieved my girl seemed as though she may have been having a bad day or just a long day at work today because she took Bella out back just fine until I heard Bella bark. I know my girl, so I assumed she didn’t allow her to administer the shot, so the way the tech came back just rubbed me the wrong way…

I extend grace to everyone and I understand my girl can be difficult. This has been discussed with previous techs and the doctors here. She immediately puts the muzzle up and says “You’re gonna have to muzzle her…” and I I told her that’s unfortunate because this is traumatic for her already and she won’t let ME muzzle her. The tech threw her hands up like “Not my problem. Idk what to tell you…” Did not provide alternate options. Told me I can enter one of the rooms and try to do it myself and so I did because I wasn’t gonna give up too easily on my girl nor did I want the tech to get bit because my girl can snap.

So I entered the room and tried. The tech comes knocking at the door and FINALLY offers a better alternative… And we left with a successful shot.

I understand if something may have transpired before I arrived but it does not make it okay for my dog to be treated as though there is no way around successful visits.

Again, I chose Good Vets because of the great reviews and have referred other pet owner friends of mine as well, but today just did not sit right with me because of this tech. So I highly encourage to ensure customer experiences are a priority for this tech in particular. Provide alternative options before you decide to completely shut down the possibility for my dog to get her due shot.

Very thorough exam of Penny.  Also got preventatives taken care of for heartworm and flea and tick.  Vet and assistant were very good in asking questions about Penny and her overall health.  Check in with assistant at front desk was quick and easy.  All staff were professional and caring.
So friendly, willing to go the extra mile, up front with pricing. Patient with my dog as she continued to bark. I was impressed with this place. Recommend
So friendly and informative,, up front with pricing.  Very patient with my dog
Thank you for your 5-star review! We truly appreciate your kind words and are so glad you had a great experience with our team. We look forward to seeing you and your pets again! 🐾 …

They were great with my sweet kitty! I will definitely be bringing my dog and other cat back for any other vet needs! They were quick, nice, and explained everything thoroughly! I also was stuck in traffic and going to be late to my appointment and they were very understanding & able to get me in! Still have to see how my baby responds to the medicine but overall very satisfied!

Fantastic experience! Dr. Luevano was wonderful with my frenchie. Staff were super friendly, office was clean, and the wait time was minimal! On the pricey side but HIGHLY recommend. Thank you Goodvets!

I am so thankful for Dr. Luevano & Ms. Teresa! They were able to treat my Rottweiler’s ear infection with minimal issues from him surprisingly! I will definitely return for all of my vet needs. The front desk receptionist was also very sweet. Super pleased with my experience!.

I can’t say enough of great things for this vet. Dr. Medina is absolutely amazing and so caring for my two dogs. The entire staff is great including the nurses and front desk staff. I highly recommend you taking your pet here!
I’ve brought my cats to Good Vets several times & am extremely grateful for their attentiveness and care. Great staff & communication.
Thank you for the 5 stars! We’re happy to hear you had a positive experience with our team. We appreciate your support and look forward to caring for your pets again! 🐾 …
Extremely helpfully in explaining our dogs condition, super great and careful with the care of our dog!!
Thank you for your 5-star review! We’re grateful for your support and glad you had a great experience with us. We look forward to seeing you and your pets again soon! 🐾 …
Thank you so much for your review!

Once again they have given us a smooth and concern free visit! Thank you for taking care of our little puppy! 🫶🏾 We will see y’all soon!

10/10 DEFINITELY RECOMMEND!🗣️😘

I have been a client of GoodVets and previously enrolled in their dog-care plan, during which time my dog received good care. Unfortunately I missed two payments and was informed the plan was canceled. In their cancellation email, the practice stated that payment would be required to “unlock” the plan and allow for continued services.
A few months later, I paid $1,000 to reinstate the plan under the understanding that this payment would fully restore coverage, enabling me to bring my dog in for care. However, when I arrived for an appointment, I was told I still owed $400 for services. This contradicted the earlier communication that once payment was made, services could continue.
I reviewed the terms of the plan and learned that continuation of service is at the provider’s discretion even after full payment. In this case, they chose not to reinstate coverage as promised.
Overall, this experience left me feeling misled. I trusted the plan’s reinstatement process and believed I was paying to renew coverage, so being asked for additional payment felt unfair and frustrating. I hope the practice can improve clarity and transparency so other clients can avoid similar disappointment. I will be calling into corporate
Thank you so much for your review!
Our little puppy Honey loves coming here! She actually enjoys it here! They are always on time and Honey is well taken care of!

I bring my Chocolate lab here. This is my 2nd visit and I am beyond happy with the care they give him. They also help me keep on track with his shots and any medication he needs. Very clean, nice staff. I’m happy to find this place for my puppy.

Clearly by this photo he is relaxed not nervous about being here so a big mom win!

We are truly grateful for the team at GoodVets. They took great care of our cat Shadow and were consistently honest, patient, and sincere throughout everything. They did everything they possibly could for him and never gave up, always hoping for the best right alongside us. When we ultimately had to say goodbye, they handled the situation with compassion and clearly understood what we were going through, making an incredibly difficult moment feel a little easier to get through.

The handwritten card signed by the entire team was a sweet surprise, with each person leaving a thoughtful message. That gesture meant so much and showed how deeply they genuinely cared. I’ll always cherish that and keep it forever.

Dr Luevano and her team made a heartbreaking experience more gentle, and we are very thankful for the comfort and support they provided every step of the way. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a veterinary team that truly cares for animals. 🐾🩵
Staff is so caring and thoughtful! We love GoodVets in Uptown!
Thank you so much for your 5-star review!
Wonderful experience! Staff was wonderful
Thank you again Doc. Kocher !!
Always friendly, prompt, communicate well and treat my pet with care and respect. Speedo says "thanks, Doc."

Had to make the incredibly hard decision to let my sweet girl rest after battling mammary cancer for a year, and this staff was so so kind and patient. They helped explain everything and never pushed and were so empathetic. They took such good care of my sweet girl during the last moments of her life and I am so grateful for their care and compassion while I said goodbye to my best friend. Rest in peace Eira ❤️‍🩹 I love you forever
I’ve always had the best experience here! They are so attentive, easy to get appointments, and so sweet to my pups!

This clinic is truly one of a kind. From the moment I walked in, Lucas at the front desk made me feel so welcome and cared for. The team was incredibly compassionate and communicative throughout the whole visit. After struggling for so long with my dog’s skin issues and chronic ear infection, they were the first to actually help and it made all the difference. Thank you so much for everything!
Amazing people and staff! Awesome environment too and pups felt right at home. 10/10 would recommend.
A new customer but I love this space. Super clean and modern, and the vets and techs are always prompt and on time.

My cats were at ease and comfortable vet and assistant were very detailed I admire the vet’s patience with my cats being that I went in there with 4 cats one which is adamant that no one touches her. The vet was able to examine and treat her with no trouble. We found our regular clinic/veterinary

This is the BEST vet clinic i have ever been too. The people who work here are beyond empathetic and kind. They treated my cat so gently and he feels and looks better the next day of treatment. This is a business you should give your money too! And they don’t over charge in fact I didn’t know about a special they had and she still applied the discount for my cats medicine. A great group of staff, very quick service, and great treatment. I rarely leave reviews but this place really made my day.
Professional and friendly service with expert knowledge. The facility is modern and clean.
Great team, kind dr., and nice building/office
The staff here are very nice and take good care of Patience whenever I bring her in. They are also very attentive and ready to answer any questions I may have.

Update:

I’d like to add that the owner of the clinic called me and showed a lot of compassion. She checked on my baby and explained the circumstances that led to my experience. Given the nature of the call, I believe my experience was probably atypical and that they probably care more about the pets than I was led to believe.

I’m absolutely appalled at this vets office. I made a new patient sick appointment for my dog who’s experiencing neurological symptoms. I contacted the vet 5 minutes before my appointment to let them know I would be 10 minutes late because when I tried to get my dog to the car, he couldn’t stand or walk and I got delayed. They texted back letting me know that if I were 15 minutes late they’d have to reschedule. Not an ounce of compassion or concern for what I’d just informed them about my pet. I arrived at the office and confirmed that there was a real person texting me and that wasn’t an automated response. I told the front desk that I was very put off and id like to speak with the vet because I’m not sure they have my business at that point. I waited 5 minutes and someone came out who wasn’t the vet and spent 5 more minutes telling me about their policy. At this point, again, no one has even asked anything about my dog. I asked where the vet was and she was preoccupied with another patient. So you need to rush me and cancel my appointment for a potentially life threatening situation with my dog but 20 minutes after my appointment start time no one has even asked to see him or so much as offered to help me carry him. I walked out. This is not the kind of vets office I want treating my pet and I don’t suggest you bring your animal here.

I took him 5 minutes up the street to another vet who saw him immediately and actually cared. For context, my appointment was at 1130 and it’s 1245 and I’ve already gotten answers about my dogs condition. There are too many vets in DFW for them to behave that way and be in business.

Recently moved to Dallas from out of state. My dog’s first exam & updated vaccines with Dr. Medina and Jocelyn made me confident we’d picked the right clinic. The love and enthusiasm they showed him was unmatched. They spoke to him like he was their own and gave him lots of attention, all while giving his shots quickly and making sure he knew it was okay. Awesome clinic and honestly a bummer that he doesn’t need Vet visits often solely because I can’t wait to go back haha
I absolutely love the vets and the customer service! Everyone is so nice and the atmosphere is very clean!!! I’d recommend them to anyone with a pet.
Thank you for your 5-star rating!
Pricey but good

Where do I even begin. The rating does not lie. They are currently operating on my pup as I am writing this. Everyone at this place shows a genuine care beyond anyone I’ve ever met. Have been with me every step of the way. I’ve never gone through this but they really know how to make everything feel okay. Want to give a big shout out to Lucas. Every single time I called he was there to help me out with any and all concerns and made sure he got me answers.
My dog Nala has been coming here for check ups and sick visits for over a year. Dr. Medina and Dr. Leuvano have both been wonderful.

I loved my experience here, the vet, the vet tech, and the receptionist were all wonderful ladies! I love how they interacted with my kittens, even pausing to play with them a little at the end of the visit! They were super clear on what they needed and extras on how to take care of them. Will definitely be using them for all my pets!
I love this place and everyone is so welcoming and informative!

Everyone at this office is kind and welcoming, from the front desk staff to the doctors. They ordered blood work and got back quickly with the results, but did not perform any sort of physical examination. I went elsewhere a week after the appointment and it turns out my dog has severe spinal arthritis. I wish the examination had been more thorough.

End to end I had such a great experience! Cute aesthetics and convenient location. Lukas (excellent customer service at the front desk and across all comms in app/phone) I hope I got his name right — made being a new client so lovely and went above and beyond to make sure we were comfortable and got everything we needed to prepare for boarding and insurance. The vet had an excellent bedside manner and is highly experienced—she is wonderful.What a great 1st vet experience.
Thank you for your 5 stars!
My first appointment was amazing , simple, easy and I left with no questions

Loved coming here and enjoyed the pleasant and relaxing vibes. Dr. Medina was very detailed and friendly, I felt like all my questions were addressed and I got a special shampoo to hopefully fix Bubby’s dry fur. :)
Doctor Medina is the very best doctor ever!! She truly cares about the pets and I can always trust her to care for my dogs 🤍 …
This team of veterinarians truly care. Kind and generous with their time.

From the moment I walked in Lucas and Lei greeted me with a smile on their face and I received nothing but the best most friendly service for my precious puppy Nami. I can’t recommend this place enough! Teresa and Dr Luevano made me feel so professionally cared for they were a delight to talk with. I knew my dog Nami was getting the best available care out there without a question in my mind. Pricing was great too and they even gave me a free first annual checkup when I booked online as a new client. This place should be your go to vet! They also gave me a goodie bag of treats on the way out and water when I walked in which was a nice gesture. If I could give this place a 6/5 stars I would!

Bear is very anxious around people, everyone was so kind and patient with him, very professional. Gave great advice, sold medicine for same price (also best price) it is available for online, and did the whole checkup for free.
Great service and in and out as always! Thanks!
Great facility! Friendly staff! 10/10! I loved how the check up exam was performed in the same room. My old vet didn’t do that, so that was a nice plus. Will definitely be returning :)

Amazing vet! I got my first puppy a few months ago and everyone at GoodVets Uptown has been so welcoming and helpful. I have a million questions every time I’m there and they always take the time to answer them and give me any advice. Definitely recommend going to them if you are looking for a vet in the Dallas area!

Unprofessional staff! I booked an 11am appointment for my pup. I was a few minutes late due to parking. As I’m walking into the clinic a staff member calls me and meets me  at the door letting me know that they can’t take my baby today or I may have so wait several hours to be seen due to an emergency surgery for another pet. Bummer! I told them that that would not work as I had an appointment that was confirmed a day prior. Fast forward over 4 staff members are miraculously working on my pup. There was no empathy or remorse for our inconvenience. The clinic manager did not accommodate me for the inconvenience, as she  initially said that should would waive the nail clipping charge. I felt rushed and like they did not want me there. I would not be returning due to their lack of professionalism and poor communication. Zero stars!

My dog loves the staff and Dr. Desiree. She gets peanut butter to distract her from shots and blood draws. The staff takes the time explain everything to me and my partner (sometimes 3 time) with out any attitude or frustration. Took the Queen of the house as well (cat) and they were very gentle with her. I recommend this vet for all your fur babies!

Nothing but 5 stars for Dr. Luevano and Team. They always make Teddy feel better and accommodate his needs as an anxious pup. If you are looking for someone to trust with your pet, Dr. Luevano is a fantastic choice.
We had a great experience at GoodVets. Everyone was friendly and clearly cared about my dog!
I was taking care of a diabetic dog and Teresa and team assisted me by showing best practices on a Saturday morning. These people love animals and it shows. Thank you guys, I am so grateful for you!
Best vet hands down! so clean and nice.

We enjoyed our first visit. Everyone was super welcoming and the vet and her assistant seemed to genuinely care about our cats. It was hands-down the best vet visit we've ever had. They took their time to talk to me about the concerns I had which I really appreciated.

Came to GoodVets after consulting at another vet and I’m 100% certain I found the best option! After hearing my concerns about my fur baby Dr. Luevano and her staff were so attentive and supportive of finding a solution and in less than an hour they found the issue and scheduled necessary surgery that same week! My cat Nova and I are so grateful for everyone at GoodVet being so kind and helpful during this scary period. 10/10 would recommend.

Always such a positive experience, everyone there is so great and helpful! The kindness and knowledgeability from the entire staff never ceases to amaze me! Couldn’t imagine taking my dog anywhere else.
My dog loves going to the vet! The staff is so caring and friendly. They always fit us in and help with any issues. We have been going to GoodVets uptown since we have had our pup (6 months).

Such a friendly staff that are attentive and loving to my cat, Delilah. This is the calmest and most comfortable I have ever seen her with a vet. Clean and well managed building. 10/10 The genuine and honest character of the vet and team is the reason we will be coming back.
This office is nice in every way. From the staff to the facility. The thing I appreciated most is the vet truly accommodated my dog, and the visit was brief but not at all rushed.

I'm extremely grateful and satisfied with the care Penelope received today at good vets uptown location. Initially, I thought I had made an appointment for her the day before, but turns out that I never confirmed it. However, Penelope had really bad discomfort and itchiness all over her body. As I walked in and told the friendly receptionist Leia about Penelope's case, she made it possible for my for fur baby to be seen last minute. I'm so thankful because a couple hours later she is feeling better. Thank you also to Dr. Luevano and Sophia! The sweetest girls all around!
